title: [応用] 複合外部キーでテナント境界を守る
statement: messagesが別藩のchannelを参照できないようにします。channelsは (tenant_id, id) を複合主キーにし、messagesの (tenant_id, channel_id) から同じ組へ複合外部キーを設定してください。

constraints.name: 参照
constraints.value: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, channel_id) REFERENCES channels(tenant_id, id)

starterSql:
CREATE TABLE channels (tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id));
CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);
solutionSql: CREATE TABLE channels (tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)); CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, channel_id) REFERENCES channels(tenant_id, id));
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('messages') WHERE "table"='channels')=2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('messages') WHERE seq=0 AND "from"='tenant_id' AND "to"='tenant_id')=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('messages') WHERE seq=1 AND "from"='channel_id' AND "to"='id')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok;
